tests.name: Select a clean adjacent target sector

data.sql: SELECT w.to_sector FROM players p JOIN sector_warps w ON w.from_sector=p.sector_id WHERE p.name='photon_restart_shooter' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planets pl JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE pl.sector_id=w.to_sector AND COALESCE(c.planetaryShields,0)>0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects e WHERE e.sector_id=w.to_sector) ORDER BY w.to_sector LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Prepare eligible shooter and target ships

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Missile Frigate'),photons=1,combat_disabled_until=0,destroyed=FALSE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_restart_shooter');

tests.name: Move target owner to adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{photon_restart_sector} WHERE name='photon_restart_target';
UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{photon_restart_sector},shields=0,combat_disabled_until=0,destroyed=FALSE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_restart_target');
SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_restart_target';

tests.name: Persist target disablement before server restart

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT combat_disabled_until FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_restart_target'))>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint AND (SELECT photons FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_restart_shooter'))=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
